sources.entry: ExcalidrawZ - Open-source native Excalidraw client with local file management and iCloud sync. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/chocoford/ExcalidrawZ) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/excalidrawz/id6636493997?platform=mac)

summary.name: ExcalidrawZ
summary.one_liner: A native Mac, iPad, and iPhone client for the Excalidraw drawing canvas, with local-first file management, history, search, and optional AI features.
use_cases: sketching diagrams and whiteboard drawings on a Mac, iPad, or iPhone
keeping drawings local with optional cloud folder sync
searching and restoring earlier versions of a canvas
importing PDFs into a drawing and exporting vector PDFs
locking sensitive drawings with Touch ID or a Recovery Key
generating diagrams or drafting edits with AI chat
summary.what_it_does: ExcalidrawZ wraps the standard Excalidraw canvas in a native Apple app and opens, creates, edits, and exports standard Excalidraw files. It stores drawings on the device by default and adds file management, iCloud-aware storage, file history, canvas search, library browsing, and quick switching. Optional connections to Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, WebDAV, or a local folder let users browse and sync Excalidraw files in chosen locations. Sensitive drawings can be encrypted and unlocked with system authentication or a Recovery Key, and per-file AI visibility keeps locked content out of AI requests. Optional AI Chat can read the canvas, propose changes with previews, generate diagrams, and connect MCP clients; LaTeX formulas and function plots are also offered.
notable: Standard Excalidraw files with native file management, history, and search
Encrypted drawings with Touch ID, Mac password, or Recovery Key unlock
Optional AI Chat that can edit the canvas with reviewable proposal previews
Open-source with a listing on awesome-mac; also on the Mac App Store
caveats: AI features rely on an AI account and credits system; usage is limited by plans and credits
Cloud storage providers are optional add-ons on top of local files
Page describes the app as Mac, iPad, and iPhone; Windows and Linux are not mentioned
